text:
Alex: Heads-up — SmallBiz Summit booth run. Need final headcount for demos, speaker confirmations, swag ship ETA. Quick thread so we can lock things this week.
Priya: Got the speaking submission updates — accepted: Alex, Jordan, and Maya (guest speaker). Alex, can you confirm slides by Wed EOD?
Sam: Swag vendor update: ordered 400 stickers, 200 tees (unisex), 50 hoodies. Vendor says ETA ~4/12 but can expedite for +$120. Thoughts?
Jordan: I can cover two demo slots (11:30 & 2pm). Need 2 laptops + dongles, plus a spare hotspot if Wi‑Fi goes weird.
Alex: Plan: Sam -> own swag pickup/logistics & labels. Priya -> speaker comms + slide reminders. Jordan -> demo kit checklist (I’ll help with the hotspot).
Sam: For label printing I’ll use the Ops-approved script: `./print_labels.sh --batch 50 --env=prod` so we can do batches at the warehouse. Packing list will include foam blocks for the backdrop rails.
OpsBot: Shipment created by Sam: carrier UPS, tracking https://track.example/1Z999AA10123456784 — ETA 2024-04-11.
Priya: Inbound lead routing: recommend QR -> short form -> webhook to HubSpot. Draft form will include UTM_campaign=smallbiz_summit and a "demo_interest" field.
Alex: Messaging quick check: booth tagline candidates — "Fast inference, predictable costs" vs "Ship LLM features, not ops". Which reads better on a 6ft banner?
Jordan: I vote "Ship LLM features, not ops" — punchy, product-forward. Use the other on the 1‑pager with a short sentence about cost controls.
Sam: T-shirt size split I requested from vendor: S:20, M:80, L:70, XL:30. If we want more S/XL I can adjust before final cut.
Priya: I’ll handle speaker calendar invites and a 15m run-through slot for Wed 10:00am. Also will add the QR workflow to the run-of-show doc.
Alex: Nice. Quick tech for webhook (Sam or Engs can review): `curl -X POST https://hooks.hubspot.example/v1/leads -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"lead_source":"SmallBizSummit","utm_campaign":"smallbiz_summit"}'` — keep auth token server-side.
Jordan: Demo kit checklist items I’ll include: 2x laptops, 2x HDMI adapters, 1x spare router, spare power strip, dongles, printed slides.
Sam: Will pick up swag and labels on Tue afternoon. If the vendor charges expedite I’ll request the $120 from marketing budget and ping @finance.
Priya: Also: we should prep a short benchmark one‑pager (latency/cost comparison) to hand out. Alex, can you or Applied ML draft a single slide?
Alex: Yes, I’ll ask Applied ML for a compact benchmark snapshot — aim for a one‑column PDF that prints well.
OpsBot: Reminder scheduled: crate pickup reminder on Tue 08:00 from Ops calendar.
Priya: Deadline: final confirmations by Tue EOD (so we can print and pack Wed). I’ll compile everything into the run-of-show doc and ping this thread. :thumbsup:
Alex: Great — thanks everyone. If anything blocks, drop it here and we’ll reassign.
